## Summary
Implements **P0.05 — Boundary hooks and seat policy** (`docs/tickets/05_P0.05__boundary-hooks.md`): the **tool layer** of §12.6's three concentric boundary layers. One `PreToolUse` hook, the **same code for every seat and engine**, with **policy supplied as per-run data** (REQ-ARCH-17). This ticket owns path/URL classification and audit-row semantics; P0.06 wires it into the SDK, P0.07 duplicates URL policy at the proxy (defense in depth), P0.08 reacts to denial counts.

Stacked on P0.04 (`stevevitali/p0-04-...`).

## What changed
Built `packages/hooks` out from its P0.01 skeleton into pure, injected-dependency policy logic (`packages/hooks/src/`):
- **`seat-tables.ts`** — the §12.6 seat mount tables as data + `compileSeatPolicy` (per-run roots/persona/tools/URL/phase).
- **`paths.ts`** — realpath resolution on the *uncollapsed* path (symlink + `..` escapes), glob matching, Bash argv tokenization + sub-command splitting, recursive-over-root detection.
- **`url-policy.ts`** — hold-out/exclusion deny (path-level, query-ignoring), server `web_fetch` disablement, calibrator allow-after-prediction via the client fetcher.
- **`hook.ts`** — `evaluateToolUse`: out-of-namespace reads, read-only writes, recursive-over-root, URL policy, `Agent` in judge-class, tool-set enforcement; an audit row per decision; `toPreToolUseResult` SDK adapter.
- **`denials.ts`** — 3-of-path abort / >20-in-phase hiccup control signals.
- **`audit.ts`** — append-only `access_log`/`fetch_log` write interface + buffered writer; 90-day retention.
- **`subagents.ts`** — subagent inheritance/attribution (REQ-DATA-12) + rendered allowed-path set (REQ-DATA-13).

## Design decisions
- The §12.6 fine-grained mounts live as `SEAT_MOUNTS` data in this package — the coarse `agent_types` namespace tokens can't express per-seat detail (`preferences.md` visibility, per-seat persona-file subsets). P0.02's code-seed is unchanged (its own comment delegates this refinement to P0.05/P0.06).
- Realpath runs on the **uncollapsed** path so a symlink-parent consumed by a following `..` can't slip past the Editor↔Drafter wall.
- Hold-out matching is on scheme+host+**path**, ignoring query, so an appended `?d=<exfil>` can't leak a hold-out (§12.8).
- Bash write-via-redirect to a read-only path is caught by the kernel read-only bind mount (§11.5) + write-back layer (§12.2), not this layer — documented defense in depth.

## Verification
`pnpm turbo build lint typecheck` → 78 tasks green · `pnpm vitest run` → 42 files / 326 tests green (91 in `@rhema/hooks`). An independent fresh-context review found 5 majors (2 widening the load-bearing boundaries) + minors; **all confirmed and fixed**, with regression tests added.

Spec: §12.6 (tool/URL layers, seat tables, denial thresholds), §12.2 (judge-class rejection), §11.3 (`AccessLogEntry`/`FetchLogEntry`), §12.10 rows 1–4.
